mechanism.claim: A volatile crypto auction whose six-alt directional breadth repeatedly occupies only a few cross-sectional sign configurations has collapsed from fragmented trading into a persistent common market mode. When the last hour confirms one broad direction, follow that mode in BTC for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict majority sign of the six alts' completed final-hour cumulative returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSER is BTC-only binary sign entropy. HVCMMI uses continuous return covariance eigenvalues. Cross-alt serial persistence uses each alt's time autocorrelation. HVCASCE instead measures Shannon entropy of the 24 categorical six-alt breadth states {-6,-4,-2,0,2,4,6}; it uses no return magnitude in the entropy, value anchor, order flow, turnover, funding, OI, premium, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour BTC realized variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular half-hour cross-sectional entropy-collapse onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.window: 24 exact aligned coherent fifteen-minute aggregates from 360 native bars_binance one-minute rows [D-6h,D) for six alts
features.alt_interval_return: log(last completed close/first completed open), finite; strict sign with exact zero coded 0
features.breadth_state: sum of six signs at each interval, one of {-6,-4,-2,0,2,4,6}
features.configuration_entropy: Shannon entropy in bits of the empirical seven-state distribution across the 24 completed intervals
features.collapse_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 2160 source-valid decisions, minimum 1440, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.final_hour_direction: sum each alt's final four interval returns; at least four of six have one common strict sign and strictly outnumber the opposite sign
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 2160 source-valid decisions, minimum 1440, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: full eligible state true now and false at immediately prior exact source-valid half-hour; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after all completed source paths are available
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent categorical cross-sectional market-mode entropy collapse

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, interval, window, state alphabet, entropy, rank, variation, confirmation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
